acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of attic insulation varies based on several factors, including the size of your attic, the current insulation's condition, the type of insulation material chosen, and the desired R-value. For homes in Irvine or Yorba Linda, a complete attic insulation project can range from a few thousand dollars to significantly more for larger homes or specialized materials. This estimate typically includes material, labor, and proper sealing of air leaks. We offer free, no-obligation estimates after an on-site assessment to provide an accurate quote tailored to your home's unique needs.
